title: Master volume through wpctl instead of libpipewire
context: The volume flyout needs read and write access to the default sink level. PipeWire has no D-Bus control surface; WirePlumber ships the supported wpctl CLI.
options: Link libpipewire and implement a registry/device listener
decision: wpctl. Three operations do not justify linking against libpipewire, and wpctl is the interface WirePlumber documents and guarantees.
consequences: The audio service reports Unavailable when wpctl is missing or no default sink exists; the volume flyout then never appears and nothing crashes.
The service is event-free (no device-change signal), so the level is re-read on demand when the flyout opens.
Migrating to libpipewire later only affects src/audio/mod.rs.
